conceptNote: 黒い文字とコーラルの映像面を、非対称な配置でまとめる。
headline: YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished refined typographic Chrome extension promotional image, compact landscape11:7 target1760x1120. Product name VERBATIM: "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen". Only these words appear, EACH ONCE and in this exact reading order YouTube → Live Chat → Fullscreen; line breaks as specified below. No slogans, labels, other text or watermark. All words easily readable at220x140, no cropped letters,7% canvas safe margins. Refined letterforms, optical kerning, comfortable leading, intentional negative space. No generic chunky bold, ultra-condensed type or dimensional/extruded letters. Use regular/medium stroke weights unless specified.
Typography and an adequately LARGE fullscreen-video/chat diagram form ONE coherent composition. The diagram: a single landscape video boundary with four clear fullscreen corner brackets; small play triangle in the open area; ONE chat pane fully INSIDE the frame with padding on all four sides. Chat about25% video width, three geometric avatar/message rows and a discreet abstract input/send line. No words inside chat. VIDEO SURFACE IS BLANK FLAT COLOR, zero scenes: NO mountains, lake, sky, sun, trees, game or photography. Never an outside sidebar. Restrained flat editorial artwork, no3D, glass/plastic sculpture, paper texture, heavy grain, glow or fake screenshot. Good visual balance between typography, frame and chat; no tiny decorative icon beside oversized type. Preserve whole composition without outer mockup border.
Composition: Verylightgrey. Name upperleft3lines YouTube / Live Chat / Fullscreen in ink regular sans withlarge counters; LiveChat slightlyitalic. Coral video diagram lower/right withgraphitechatpane andwhitecorners/play. Precise asymmetric editorial grid, 35%white breathing space, balanced letter/diagram weights.
If using TOP/BOTTOM composition: the name occupies aboutthetopquarter and the landscapevideo about65%canvaswidth below with comfortablegap. Keep aspect11:7 forWHOLEtile, and preserve generous safe margins; do not outputultrawidepanorama.
Critical geometry: the FOUR fullscreen corners must surround the ENTIRE video INCLUDING the overlaid chat. Right corners at the FAR RIGHT perimeter beyond the chat, never at a seam just left of chat. Leave a visible strip of video around all FOUR sides of chat. No vertical divider; video continues behind chat. This is one video surface, NOT side-by-side video and sidebar.
